input.quote: 11.2 Indemnification of AbbVie. Harpoon shall indemnify AbbVie, its Affiliates and its and their respective directors, officers, employees, and agents (the "AbbVie Indemnitees"), and defend and save each of them harmless, from and against any and all Losses in connection with any and all Third Party Claims incurred by or rendered against the AbbVie Indemnitees arising from or occurring as a result of: [***]
input.rationale: Article 11's architecture already meets the structural preferred elements in our favour: Harpoon expressly indemnifies and defends AbbVie and its Affiliates against Third Party Claims (11.2), with prompt written notice (11.3), allocation of control of the defence (11.4.1, with AbbVie controlling where Harpoon does not assume) and reasonable cooperation (11.4.4). What fails is scope: the trigger lists of both 11.1 and 11.2 are redacted, so no operative text evidences that Harpoon's indemnity reaches third-party IP infringement, Harpoon's breach of Applicable Law, a Harpoon-caused data breach, or Harpoon's gross negligence/willful misconduct, and nothing confines our own 11.1 indemnity to AbbVie-provided content and AbbVie's breach of law. Section 7.4's "Subject to Section 11.2" cross-reference is inference only and cannot substitute for a trigger. We therefore add the four Harpoon-side triggers as an additive "without limiting the foregoing" list inside 11.2 (so any equivalent redacted trigger is preserved rather than duplicated or overwritten) and add one sentence limiting 11.1. We do not add the fallback's 3x-annual-fees super-cap: Harpoon's indemnity is currently uncapped (11.5 restricts only consequential damages), which is better for us.

proposal.summary: Add the four Harpoon-side indemnity triggers to Section 11.2 and cap the scope of AbbVie's indemnity in Section 11.1.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have confirmed in Section 11.2 that Harpoon's indemnity covers third-party IP infringement, Harpoon's breach of Applicable Law, Harpoon-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of our data, and Harpoon's gross negligence or willful misconduct, and we have limited our own indemnity in Section 11.1 to AbbVie-provided content and AbbVie's breach of Applicable Law. Both edits are additive to the existing lists, so any equivalent trigger already in the redacted text is preserved.

ops.text: AbbVie's indemnification obligations under this Section 11.1 are limited to Third Party Claims to the extent arising from content or materials provided by AbbVie and AbbVie's breach of Applicable Law.

Without limiting the foregoing, the matters for which Harpoon shall indemnify and defend the AbbVie Indemnitees under this Section 11.2 include: (a) any Third Party Claim alleging that the Licensed Compounds or Licensed Products, or the intellectual property licensed to AbbVie hereunder, infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right of a Third Party; (b) Harpoon's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of AbbVie's Confidential Information or data caused by Harpoon; and (d) Harpoon's gross negligence or willful misconduct.
